penetrate the market: The small Taiwanese company worked hard for years before it could finally penetrate the market in Japan.
這家台灣小公司努力了好幾年，才終於打入日本市場。
penetrate the defense: Our team tried again and again but could not penetrate the defense of the strongest school in the league.
我們的球隊一再嘗試，卻始終無法突破聯盟中最強學校的防線。
penetrate the darkness: The bright light from the lighthouse can penetrate the darkness and guide ships safely back to the harbor.
燈塔的強光能穿透黑暗，引導船隻安全返回港口。
penetrate one's mind: The teacher's kind words slowly began to penetrate his mind, and he finally stopped feeling so hopeless.
老師親切的話語慢慢深入他的心中，他終於不再那麼絕望。
the news penetrated: At first nobody reacted, but when the news penetrated the quiet village, everyone rushed out to the streets.
一開始沒有人有反應，但當消息滲透進這座安靜的村莊時，大家都衝到街上。
perceive a threat: When animals perceive a threat in the forest, they usually freeze or run away as fast as they can.
動物在森林中察覺到威脅時，通常會僵住不動或盡快逃跑。
be perceived as: Although he is only shy, he is often perceived as rude by classmates who don't know him well.
雖然他只是害羞，但不太認識他的同學常常把他視為沒禮貌的人。
perceive a change: Dogs can perceive a change in their owner's mood even before the owner says a single word.
狗甚至在主人開口說話之前，就能感知主人情緒的變化。
perceive the difference: The two songs sound almost the same, so only trained musicians can perceive the difference between them.
這兩首歌聽起來幾乎一樣，所以只有受過訓練的音樂家能分辨出它們之間的差異。
perform a task: Robots in modern factories can perform a task like packing boxes much faster than human workers.
現代工廠裡的機器人執行像裝箱這樣的任務，速度比人類工人快得多。
perform surgery: The doctor had to perform surgery on the injured boy right away because he was losing a lot of blood.
醫生必須立刻為受傷的男孩動手術，因為他失血很多。
perform well in exams: Students who get enough sleep usually perform well in exams because their minds are clear and calm.
睡眠充足的學生通常考試表現好，因為他們頭腦清楚又冷靜。
perform a duty: As class leader, she must perform a duty every morning, which is checking who is absent.
身為班長，她每天早上必須履行一項職責，就是點名看誰缺席。
perform a miracle: Our team was losing by twenty points, so we needed someone to perform a miracle in the last quarter.
我們隊落後二十分，所以需要有人在最後一節創造奇蹟。
the car performs well: Even on steep mountain roads in heavy rain, the car performs well and feels very safe to drive.
即使在大雨中的陡峭山路上，這台車性能依然很好，開起來很安全。
permit smoking: Most restaurants in Taiwan do not permit smoking indoors, so smokers have to go outside.
台灣大多數餐廳不允許在室內吸菸，所以吸菸者必須到外面去。
weather permitting: Weather permitting, our class will go hiking in Yangmingshan this Saturday and have a picnic at the top.
天氣允許的話，我們班這週六會去陽明山健行，並在山頂野餐。
permit oneself a smile: After months of hard training, the tired coach finally decided to permit himself a smile when his team won.
經過數月的辛苦訓練，疲憊的教練在球隊獲勝時終於忍不住露出一抹微笑。
permit access: The school will only permit access to the science lab when a teacher is present.
學校只有在老師在場時才允許進入科學實驗室。
persist in doing: Even though his parents disagreed, he would persist in doing what he loved and became a famous dancer.
儘管父母反對，他仍堅持做自己熱愛的事，最後成為知名舞者。
the problem persists: I have restarted my computer three times, but the problem persists, so I need to call a technician.
我已經重新開機三次了，但問題持續存在，所以我需要打電話找技術人員。
persist with the treatment: The doctor told her to persist with the treatment for another month, even if she started to feel better.
醫生告訴她要再持續治療一個月，即使她開始覺得好轉了也一樣。
symptoms persist: If your symptoms persist for more than three days, you should go back to the clinic to see the doctor.
如果你的症狀持續超過三天，就應該回診所看醫生。
persuade someone to: After an hour of friendly discussion, I finally managed to persuade my dad to let me join the trip.
經過一小時友善的討論，我終於說服我爸讓我參加這趟旅行。
be persuaded of the truth: After reading all the evidence carefully, the reporter began to be persuaded of the truth of her story.
仔細讀完所有證據後，這位記者開始相信她所說的是真相。
persuade the jury: The lawyer used clear evidence and strong arguments to persuade the jury that his client was innocent.
律師用明確的證據和有力的論點說服陪審團，讓他們相信他的當事人是無辜的。
phase out old models: The phone company plans to phase out old models slowly over the next two years instead of stopping all at once.
這家手機公司計劃在未來兩年內逐步淘汰舊款，而不是一次全部停產。
phase in new rules: To give students time to adjust, the school decided to phase in new rules about phone use step by step.
為了讓學生有時間適應，學校決定逐步實施關於手機使用的新規定。
a passing phase: My little brother loves dinosaurs now, but Mom thinks it is just a passing phase that will end soon.
我弟弟現在很愛恐龍，但媽媽認為那只是很快就會結束的暫時階段。
in phases: The new subway line is so long that it will be built in phases over the next ten years.
這條新捷運線很長，所以會在未來十年內分階段興建。
